recording_scope: Primary Standard Thai production: approximately 7 hours interview speech plus 5 hours controlled word-list/sentence reading from 49 speakers.
manual_scope: ASR/MAUS alignment followed by manual correction by phonetically trained native Thai speakers; orthographic, word, syllable, phone and toneme annotations qualify. Do not treat pre-correction automatic output as core.
large_archive_policy: Do not commit the 6.2 GB C-COST.zip/audio archive to GitHub. Retain authoritative Zenodo URL and MD5; ingest TextGrid annotations and structured metadata when file-level access permits.
